occurrence_sentence: PRESS RELEASE — Rigetti Computing, Inc. (Nasdaq: RGTI) ("Rigetti" or the "Company"), a pioneer in full-stack quantum-classical computing, announced the launch of its Novera™ QPU, a 9-qubit quantum processing unit (QPU) based on the Company's fourth generation Ankaa™-class architecture featuring tunable couplers and a square lattice for denser connectivity and fast 2-qubit operations.
